title: ask command optimization smoke tests
desc: Smoke-test, route-validate, and benchmark wkappbot ask for Claude, GPT, Gemini, triad. Three modes: BASIC (help/wiring), FULL (live dispatch + final-answer wait), BENCHMARK (FULL + dispatch/completion timings + JSON output + optional baseline regression check). Use after changing ask routing, prompt-pump, CDP worker, or any path on the user-perceived speed-of-dispatch axis.
steps: MODES: -Quick (alias BASIC) checks help, skill registration, source wiring (no live calls). -Full performs live dispatch + final-answer detection. -Benchmark = -Full + per-provider dispatch latency + completion time + JSON results + optional -Baseline diff. Default (no flags) = BASIC.
BENCHMARK output: bench-results.json with timestamp_utc, commit, dispatchMs, completionMs per provider. Use -ResultsPath to override path. Track this file across commits to spot regressions.

BASELINE diff: -Baseline path.json compares against previous run. Fails if dispatch regression > -DispatchRegressionMs (default 500) or completion > -CompletionRegressionMs (default 5000). Pin a known-good baseline before optimization spikes; re-pin after improvement is verified.

TUNING TARGETS: dispatch latency = launcher + Core + provider-pick + log-spawn time before 'dispatched to background' line. CLI parity goal: <300ms cold, <100ms warm. Completion time = end-to-end: dispatch start to [ASK_FULL_ANSWER_END] marker (TITLE: + FILE_TITLE: present).

RUN PATTERNS: local quick check before commit -> -Quick; before merge -> -Full; nightly perf tracker -> -Benchmark -Baseline benchmarks/last-known-good.json. CI is BASIC-only by default to avoid live API costs.
author: claude
